title: DOW-UAP-D092, Department of the Air Force Committee to Review Project Bluebook, 1966-1967
doc_notes: This document is a collection of memoranda and reports from the USAF Scientific Advisory Board regarding the review of Project Blue Book and the implementation of scientific investigations into UFO sightings.

incidents.summary: Tremonton, Utah sighting of multiple objects captured on 1600 frames of Kodachrome film.
incidents.explanation: Panel concluded objects were likely birds or reflections, not self-luminous.
incidents.quote: The Panel studied these films, the case history, ATIC's interpretation, and received a briefing by representatives of the USN Photo Interpretation Laboratory

incidents.summary: Great Falls, Montana sighting of objects.
incidents.explanation: Objects strongly suspected of being reflections of aircraft.
incidents.quote: The objects in the Great Falls sighting are strongly suspected of being reflections of aircraft known to have been in the area.
Major Quintella did visit the scene of the Ravenna siting at a later date.
